title: Workday Consultant
summary: A Workday consultant sets up, connects and supports Workday, the cloud system many companies use for HR, payroll data and talent. Technical consultants build the integrations and reports that move employee data to payroll, benefits and other systems, working with HR teams and a client's IT team.
dailyDuties: Build EIB loads and Core Connector or Studio integrations
Write XSLT to reshape data for payroll and benefits vendors
Create calculated fields and custom reports for HR
Fix failed integrations and data errors in production
Test changes before each Workday release
Meet HR users to gather requirements and write specs

skills.expectation: Build and support Workday integrations with EIB, Core Connectors, Studio and web services
Know HCM business processes, security groups, calculated fields and custom reports
Transform data with XML, XSLT and XPath
Call and expose REST and SOAP web services
Turn HR and payroll needs into integration and report specs
Test integrations end to end and support HR users in acceptance testing
Explain designs and issues to HR teams and vendors
Prepare and check EIB load sheets and data migration files
Handle production support tickets and Workday release changes
Connect Workday through middleware such as MuleSoft
Deliver in Workday deployment phases or sprints
Coordinate with payroll, benefits and third-party vendors
